body:
New I-keybind Inventory screen in battlegrounds_gui: real navigable list (Up/Down/Escape), reuses cmdInventory's own bracketed item-id output the AH's Sell screen already parses. Dedicated globals matching the Town Shop menu's own one-menu-one-set-of-globals precedent, not a reuse of the Auction House's. Deliberate v0: no Enter action, browsing only, matching 'click functionality later, not needed now.' Full WASM build clean, commit 7f6404c. Redeployed all 4 real artifacts, live-verified real 200s.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-INV-93911 shipped: real FFXI-style Inventory screen
